description: This file defines the JobPoller class, responsible for managing and executing jobs asynchronously within the OFBiz framework. It includes thread pool management, job queuing, and dynamic reconfiguration based on service configuration changes.

classes.name: JobInvokerThreadFactory
classes.description: Custom thread factory for naming job invocation threads.

classes.name: JobManagerPoller
classes.description: Runnable class that periodically polls registered JobManagers for new jobs to enqueue.

methods.name: createThreadPoolExecutor
methods.description: Creates and initializes the thread pool executor with configuration parameters, falling back to defaults if configuration is unavailable.

methods.name: createPriorityComparator
methods.description: Defines the comparison logic for prioritizing jobs in the thread pool queue based on priority and start time.

methods.name: pollWaitTime
methods.description: Retrieves the wait time between polling iterations from configuration.

methods.name: queueSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size limit of the job queue from configuration.

methods.name: pollEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether polling is enabled in the current configuration.
